claims.value: Laguna XS.2 is a 33B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 3B activated parameters per token designed for agentic coding and long-horizon work on a local machine.
claims.evidence: Laguna XS.2 is a 33B total parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 3B activated parameters per token
Native reasoning support: Interleaved thinking between tool calls with support for enabling and disabling thinking per-request

claims.value: Laguna XS.2 is a 33B MoE model with 3B activated params per token. It uses Sliding Window Attention with per-head gating in 30 of 40 layers. It uses sigmoid gating with per-layer rotary scales, KV cache quantized to FP8, and supports interleaved reasoning.
claims.evidence: Training: pre-training, post-training and reinforcement learning stages

claims.value: Laguna XS.2 is a 33B MoE model with 3B activated params per token, 256 experts with 1 shared expert, 40 layers (10 global attention, 30 sliding window), sliding window of 512 tokens, and FP8 KV cache.
Laguna XS.2 is trained with the Muon optimizer using pre-training, post-training and reinforcement learning stages.
Laguna XS.2 is an Apache 2.0 licensed model.
